changes.profile_in_filing: Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, aged sixty-six (66) years, is the Executive Director of the Bank and heads the Human Resources, Corporate Legal, Group Oversight & Secretarial, Investment Banking, Information Security Group, Ethics Function and Fraud & Vigilance functions of the Bank. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from University of Delhi and is an Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
